task.manifest:
name: user-badge
kind: forecast
task_type: binary_classification
description: Predict if each user will receive in a new badge the next 2 years.
entity_table: users
entity_col: UserId
target_col: WillGetBadge
time_col: timestamp
timedelta: 91 days
sql: |-
  SELECT
      timestamp,
      CAST(UserId AS BIGINT) AS UserId,
      WillGetBadge
  FROM (
  SELECT
      t.timestamp,
      u.Id as UserId,
  CASE WHEN
      COUNT(b.Id) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS WillGetBadge
  FROM
      timestamps t
  LEFT JOIN
      users u
  ON
      u.CreationDate <= t.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN
      badges b
  ON
      u.Id = b.UserID
      AND b.Date > t.timestamp
      AND b.Date <= t.timestamp + INTERVAL '{timedelta}'
  GROUP BY
      t.timestamp,
      u.Id
  )
  WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
manifest_version: 1
